title: State opposes bail but does nothing to finish trial: Supreme Court flags shocking delay in 2022 murder trial
description: The Supreme Court on Friday expressed severe displeasure over the lethargic pace of a pending murder trial in Maharashtra, noting that an accused in the case had remained in jail for over four years with only two out of forty-five witnesses being examined [Kelvin Chindozie Okoro v.
